proposed_by: agent, 16 October 2026 (all-action integration); recorded as a SECOND clip per person beside the accepted 270 s v1 clip, which stays the frozen pilot clip
purpose: elicit every action of the six-action vocabulary with fixed attempt counts so that release, finger-press, axial rotation, normal translation (shake) and hard press (squeeze) get labelled opportunities; grasp and release counts per person are known in advance

objects.cup: the matte cup of the v1 clip (grasp, carry, place, shake)
objects.jar: a screw-lid jar whose lid turns with light force (axial rotation; the body is the support object)
objects.bottle: a soft squeeze bottle or toothpaste tube, placed above the cup for the squeeze (hard press)
objects.box: a stiff box or phone-sized block with a clearly marked top spot to press with the index finger (finger-press)

label_rules_reference: project notes, 'Label rules for the six actions - 16 October 2026 (proposed)'

blocks.instruction: Rest both hands flat on the table, palms down; the cup, jar, bottle and box in view; 3-5 s of slow head turning with the hands still.
GRASP and RELEASE: right hand grasps the cup, lifts it 10 cm, holds 2 s, lowers and places it, returns to rest. Three attempts. Then the left hand, three attempts. Rest 3 s between attempts.

AXIAL ROTATION: left hand holds the jar body on the table; right hand grasps the lid and turns it a quarter turn to loosen, then a quarter turn to tighten; release the lid; rest. Three attempts. Then swap hands, three attempts.
SHAKE (normal translation): right hand grasps the cup, lifts it and shakes it up and down three times quickly, holds still 1 s, places it; rest. Three attempts. Then the left hand, three attempts.
SQUEEZE (hard press): right hand grasps the bottle, lifts it, holds it above the cup opening and squeezes once for 1 s; places the bottle; rest. Three attempts. Then the left hand, three attempts.

FINGER-PRESS: with an open hand, extend the index finger and press the marked spot on the box top once, hold 1 s, return to rest. Three attempts per hand (right, then left). The other hand stays at rest.
CONTACT WITHOUT REQUEST: rest the right hand on the cup 3 s without grasping; hover over the box without pressing; withdraw. Once per hand.
Finish at rest with both hands visible.

note: G and R counts include the grasp and placement inside the rotation, shake and squeeze blocks. The clip is 180 s so that, with the 270 s v1 clip, a person's session stays under the 12 GiB extraction cap at 640x480 only when recorded as two separate files; declare the roles of both clips before any output is viewed.
